goal: Implement two independent formatters, then integrate and verify both.
constraints: Prefer the least expensive capable model
Workers author only their owned source and test files; the main Agent runs checks and owns Git, dependency installation and shared build/cache writes

models.description: Local, well-specified implementation with direct tests
Cross-module reasoning, ambiguous requirements and integration

tasks.inputs: Date format contract is fixed; input is an ISO date string
tasks.acceptance: Specified valid and invalid date examples pass

tasks.inputs: Currency and rounding contract is fixed
tasks.acceptance: Specified currency and rounding examples pass

tasks.summary: Integrate the two formatters and verify the public API
tasks.inputs: Use the accepted date and money task artifacts
tasks.deliverable: Integrated public API and validation report
tasks.acceptance: Public API examples and relevant existing checks pass

plans.description: Both contracts are fixed and writes are disjoint; run both small implementations concurrently
Run only the date task when the proposed parallel split is not semantically independent
Integrate only after both implementations have been accepted
